command:
set -u
check_user=policycheck
id "$check_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 && userdel "$check_user"
useradd -M -s /sbin/nologin "$check_user"

one_class=$(head -c 12 /dev/zero | tr '\000' 'a')
printf '%s:%s\n' "$check_user" "$one_class" | chpasswd >/tmp/policy-one-class.out 2>&1
one_rc=$?
printf '12-character one-class candidate: rc=%s (expected nonzero)\n' "$one_rc"
sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/policy-one-class.out

short_candidate="$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'A-Z' </dev/urandom | head -c 3)$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'a-z' </dev/urandom | head -c 3)$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc '0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 3)!@"
printf '%s:%s\n' "$check_user" "$short_candidate" | chpasswd >/tmp/policy-short.out 2>&1
short_rc=$?
printf '11-character four-class candidate: rc=%s (expected nonzero)\n' "$short_rc"
sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/policy-short.out

strong_candidate="$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'A-Z' </dev/urandom | head -c 3)$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'a-z' </dev/urandom | head -c 3)$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc '0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 3)!@#"
printf '%s:%s\n' "$check_user" "$strong_candidate" | chpasswd >/tmp/policy-strong.out 2>&1
strong_rc=$?
printf '12-character four-class candidate: rc=%s (expected zero)\n' "$strong_rc"
sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/policy-strong.out
printf 'Resulting account status: '; passwd -S "$check_user"

rm -f /tmp/policy-one-class.out /tmp/policy-short.out /tmp/policy-strong.out
userdel "$check_user"
printf 'Temporary validation account removed: '; if id "$check_user" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'no\n'; else printf 'yes\n'; fi

if [ "$one_rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$short_rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$strong_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
